atoms.a: African Americans were free to live in any neighbourhood they chose.
Black and white children attended the same well-funded schools.
The Jim Crow laws reinforced racial segregation in the Southern states.
African Americans' voting rights were restricted by poll taxes and literacy tests.
Public places like schools, buses, and restrooms were divided by race.
